qt2_exclusion_notice.rationale: Door slabs are scrutinized surfaces — occupants view daily at close range, touch frequently. QT2 economy-grade prep and inspection is not acceptable for doors. Blocking/sticking issues at QT2 quality level cause functional failures.
qt2_exclusion_notice.consequence: All tasks in this spec have appears_in_tiers: [QT3, QT4, QT5]. QT2 is not offered for door slab painting.

sop_modules.name: Door Painting Setup
sop_modules.description: Floor protection and hardware handling for door painting. Hardware removal conditional on spray method.

tasks.name: Floor Protection Setup
tasks.description: Set up drop cloth or rosin paper under door being painted. Protect floor from drips and overspray.
tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Protection is identical at all applicable tiers.

tasks.name: Spray Protection Setup
tasks.description: Mask wall surfaces and extend floor protection for spray overspray. Includes door swing arc area.
tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Protection is identical at all applicable tiers.

tasks.name: Remove Door Hardware
tasks.description: Remove lockset, strike plate, and hinges (or swap to dummy hinges). Bag and label hardware per door. ~20 min per door for full removal, ~15 min for hinge mask/swap.

quality_notes.all: All hardware bagged and labeled. Hinge pins stored safely.

tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Hardware handling is identical at all applicable tiers.

tasks.name: Mask Door Hardware
tasks.description: Mask hinges and latch hardware with tape when brush application is used. ~5 min per hinge, ~5 min for lockset.

quality_notes.all: Complete coverage of all hardware faces

tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Hardware masking is identical at all applicable tiers.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Floor protection first, then spray protection (if spray), then hardware handling.

sop_modules.name: Door Initial Preparation
sop_modules.description: Surface prep before first coat. Includes inspection, sanding, filling, and MDF edge sealing. This is the HEAVY LIFT prep — distinct from interstage light maintenance.

tasks.name: Inspect Door Surface
tasks.description: Visual inspection of each door face. Assess factory primer condition, identify defects (dents, scratches, fastener holes), check edges for damage. Mark defects for repair.

quality_notes.QT3: Note obvious defects — dents, holes, damaged primer
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic inspection, mark all visible defects at 3 feet
quality_notes.QT5: Critical inspection under raking light, mark all imperfections

tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Inspection intensity scales from QT3 (obvious defects) through QT5 (critical raking light inspection).

tasks.name: Sand Door Surface (Prep)
tasks.description: Scuff sand factory primer with 180-grit for adhesion. Bare wood: full sand 150-grit. MDF: 120-150 on edges, 180 on faces.

quality_notes.QT3: Scuff sand for adhesion — uniform scratch pattern
quality_notes.QT4: Full sand 180-grit — entire surface, edges included
quality_notes.QT5: Thorough sand 150-180 grit — perfect uniform surface

tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Sanding intensity scales with tier — scuff at QT3, full sand at QT4, thorough at QT5.

tasks.name: Fill Fastener Holes
tasks.description: Fill nail holes from pre-hung door installation with lightweight spackle. Sand smooth after drying.

quality_notes.QT5: Fill every hole, no matter how small

tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Fill scope scales with tier — obvious holes at QT3, all visible at QT4, every hole at QT5.

tasks.name: Sand Filled Areas
tasks.description: Sand filler smooth, feather edges to blend with surrounding surface.

quality_notes.QT3: Knock down ridges, flush not required

tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Fill sanding quality scales — ridges down at QT3, flush at QT4, invisible at QT5.

tasks.name: Clean Sanding Dust
tasks.description: Remove all sanding dust from door surfaces with tack cloth. Critical for adhesion and finish quality.

quality_notes.all: All dust removed — surface must be clean to touch

tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Dust removal is identical at all applicable tiers.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect → Sand → Fill → Sand Fill → Edge Seal (if MDF) → Clean Dust. All prep complete before primer or first finish coat.

sop_modules.name: Door Primer Application
sop_modules.description: Apply primer coat to door faces and edges. Conditional on substrate_condition = bare_wood or user override for factory-primed.

tasks.name: Spray Primer on Door
tasks.description: Apply primer coat via airless sprayer (310-411 tip). Cover face, all assigned edges. Maintain proper distance and overlap for even film.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks at any quality tier.

tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Application quality (no drips/sags/holidays) is identical at all tiers — technique failures are never acceptable.

tasks.name: Brush Primer on Door
tasks.description: Apply primer coat with brush. Panel doors: panels first → rails → stiles → edges. Flush doors: systematic coverage.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks at any quality tier.

tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Application quality (no drips/sags/holidays) is identical at all tiers.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Prime after initial prep. Primer is conditional — skip if factory-primed and assessed acceptable.

sop_modules.name: Door Interstage Process
sop_modules.description: Light maintenance cycle between coats. Runs AFTER each coat EXCEPT the final coat. Per Fine Finish Doctrine §5.3 and §7.

tasks.name: Inspect Coat
tasks.description: Visual inspection of applied coat. Look for dust nibs, missed areas, surface texture issues. NOT looking for application failures (runs, sags, drips) — those indicate technique failure.

quality_notes.QT4: Systematic scan at 3 feet — mark all visible defects
quality_notes.QT5: Lighted critical inspection at arm's length — zero tolerance

tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Interstage inspection intensity scales — quick glance at QT3 through critical inspection at QT5.

tasks.name: Light Sand Between Coats
tasks.description: Scuff sand entire door surface between coats for adhesion and smoothness. Grit per quality tier: QT3=spot sand only, QT4=220 grit full, QT5=320 grit thorough.

quality_notes.QT3: Spot sand only — visible nibs, rough spots
quality_notes.QT4: Light full sand 220 grit — entire surface
quality_notes.QT5: Thorough full sand 320 grit — uniform scratch pattern

tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Interstage sanding scales — spot sand at QT3, full 220 at QT4, thorough 320 at QT5.

tasks.name: Patch/Repair Defects
tasks.description: Fill any defects found during inspection. Patch damage, address issues from previous coat.
tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Interstage repair scope scales — glaring defects at QT3, all marked at QT4, every defect at QT5.

tasks.name: Clean Sanding Dust (Interstage)
tasks.description: Remove sanding dust with tack cloth before next coat.

quality_notes.all: Complete dust removal before next coat

tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Interstage dust removal is identical at all applicable tiers.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect → Light Sand → Patch (if needed) → Clean. Runs after each coat except the final coat. Fine Finish Doctrine §5.3.

sop_modules.name: Door Finish Coat Application
sop_modules.description: Apply finish coat to door faces and edges. 2 coats standard (3 light coats for louvered doors). Panel door sequence: panels → rails → stiles → edges.

tasks.name: Spray Finish Coat on Door
tasks.description: Apply finish coat via airless sprayer (310-411 tip for fine atomization). Even film, proper overlap. Panel doors: spray panels, then rails, then stiles, then edges. Louvered doors: lighter coats to manage drip risk.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks at any quality tier.

tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Application quality (no drips/sags/holidays) is identical at all tiers — technique failures are never acceptable.

tasks.name: Brush Finish Coat on Door
tasks.description: Apply finish coat with quality brush. Panel door sequence: cut in panel edges → fill panels with mini roller → horizontal rails → vertical stiles → edges. Flush doors: systematic strokes, lay-off technique.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks at any quality tier.

tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Application quality (no drips/sags/holidays) is identical at all tiers.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Standard: 2 finish coats with interstage between. Louvered doors: 3 light coats per Doors Doctrine §12.2.

sop_modules.name: French Door Glass Masking
sop_modules.description: Mask glass panes on french doors before spray or brush application. Major labor component of french door work. 80-120% additional labor over flush baseline.

tasks.name: Mask Glass Panes
tasks.description: Apply masking tape and paper to each glass pane. Cut tape precisely along muntins. Critical for clean paint lines.

quality_notes.all: Precise tape lines along all muntin edges. No exposed glass in paint zone.

tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Glass masking precision is identical at all applicable tiers.

tasks.name: Remove Glass Masking
tasks.description: Remove masking from glass panes. Pull tape at 45-degree angle while paint is still slightly tacky for cleanest line.
tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Glass unmasking is identical at all applicable tiers.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Mask before first coat. Unmask after final coat. May need to re-mask between coats if tape lifts.

sop_modules.name: Door Painting Cleanup
sop_modules.description: Final inspection, hardware reinstall, protection removal.

tasks.name: Final Door Inspection
tasks.description: Final quality check of all painted door surfaces. Verify coverage, edge quality, finish uniformity. Touch up as needed.

quality_notes.QT3: Quick glance at 6 feet — no obvious defects
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic scan at 3 feet — no visible defects
quality_notes.QT5: Critical inspection at arm's length — zero tolerance

tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Final inspection intensity scales — quick glance at QT3, systematic scan at QT4, critical at QT5.

tasks.name: Reinstall Door Hardware
tasks.description: Reinstall lockset, strike plate, and hinges (or swap back from dummy hinges). Verify door operation. 10-20 min per door.

quality_notes.all: Hardware properly aligned and functional. No paint on visible hardware surfaces.

tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Hardware reinstallation is identical at all applicable tiers.

tasks.name: Remove Hardware Masking
tasks.description: Remove masking tape from hinges and hardware.
tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Hardware unmasking is identical at all applicable tiers.

tasks.name: Floor Protection Teardown
tasks.description: Remove floor protection materials.
tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Protection teardown is identical at all applicable tiers.

tasks.name: Clean Tools
tasks.description: Clean brushes, spray equipment, rollers. Proper storage or disposal.
tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs require minimum QT3. Tool cleanup is identical at all applicable tiers.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Final inspect → Hardware reinstall/unmask → Floor protection teardown → Clean tools.

round_configurations.name: Prime + 2 Finish Coats (Bare Wood)
round_configurations.description: Full system for bare wood doors: primer → interstage → finish coat 1 → interstage → finish coat 2
round_configurations.notes: Interstage after primer and after finish coat 1. Final inspection after finish coat 2.

round_configurations.name: 2 Finish Coats (Factory Primed)
round_configurations.description: Factory primed doors: prep → finish coat 1 → interstage → finish coat 2
round_configurations.notes: No primer coat — scuff sand factory primer in prep phase. Interstage after finish coat 1 only.

round_configurations.name: 3 Light Finish Coats (Louvered)
round_configurations.description: Louvered doors: 3 light spray coats instead of 2 standard. Reduces drip risk on louver slats.
round_configurations.notes: Per Doors Doctrine §12.2. 3 light coats preferred over 2 normal coats. Spray-only practical.
